name: Hotel De Roode Leeuw, Damrak
surveyedSource: 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell of BAG pand 0363100012168115 (3DBAG CC BY 4.0, BAG CC0) in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/roode-leeuw-damrak-footprints.json, bag-shell-prepare.ts); the Damrak front and the 1935 terrace read from the rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas TMX7316010203-002031_pano_0003_000033 (2021) and TMX7316010203-001658_pano_0000_001902 (2020), CC BY 4.0; the Damraksteeg corner from TMX7316010203-001658_pano_0000_002098 (2020). attribution.title: Hotel De Roode Leeuw, Damrak 93-94, Amsterdam (1911, Foeke Kuipers)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012168115 (CC0): the five-bay buff brick Damrak front with its pilasters, heraldic shields, round-arched second floor with bowed iron balconies, paired third-floor windows and railed fourth floor, the roof letters, and the 1935 covered terrace with its sign band, white clerestory and name-board balcony rail, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
